{{Top|leg}}
'''System communications satellite 355-D''' as a [[communications satellite]] located in the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]]. A communication from the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' to [[Estimable Epicures]] was routed through the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] where it was intercepted by [[Cecil Noone's crew]]. This allowed the [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] to infiltrate the catering company in order to pull off a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] on the Herdship.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
